agenticCommerceTracking.description: Configure the affiliate and campaign codes that will be embedded in product URLs of this channel's feeds. These codes identify orders and customers referred from this Agentic Commerce channel.

introduction.description: This Sales Channel generates a Google Merchant Center-compatible XML product feed so your products can appear in Google Shopping and AI shopping surfaces. In Merchant Center, add the export URL below as a scheduled file fetch under Settings › Data sources.
introduction.title: How to: Setup and connection

google.stepByStep:
• Create a Merchant Center account at merchants.google.com and verify your online store URL
  • In Merchant Center, open Settings › Data sources and click Add product source
  • Choose File, then Add a scheduled fetch from a URL, and paste the export URL (below) as the file URL
  • Make sure the export URL is publicly reachable (no authentication required)
  • Review the Google product data specification and adjust attributes if needed

introduction.description: This Sales Channel generates a JSONL product feed so your products can appear in ChatGPT search results. To do this, you have to apply as a merchant and share the feed URL with OpenAI. Everything else is explained in the step-by-step guide below.
introduction.title: How to: Setup and connection

open-ai.stepByStep:
• Apply as a merchant at chatgpt.com/merchants
  • Copy the export URL (below) and share it with OpenAI according to the Product feeds docs
  • Make sure the export URL is publicly accessible

ucp.cardIntro: Configure how this sales channel is exposed to AI agents over the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP): which capabilities agents may use, how requests are secured, and which profile they discover.
ucp.docsLinkLabel: Learn more about the UCP settings in the documentation
ucp.platformAllowlistHelpText: Enter the host of the platform's profile URL. Subdomains count too: platform.example also covers api.platform.example.
ucp.platformAllowlistHintAll: Every platform with a valid profile can use this sales channel. Platforms listed here are exempt from the limit on how often the shop looks up unknown platforms. If your developer set an agent allowlist for this channel, it still applies.
ucp.platformAllowlistHintListed: Only the listed platforms can use this sales channel. Without entries, only agents whose profile is hosted on this shop's own domain are accepted. If your developer set other allowlists for this channel, those take precedence.
ucp.platformAllowlistInvalid: Enter a host name such as platform.example, or paste the platform's profile URL.
ucp.platformPolicyHelpText: Agents identify themselves with a profile URL. "All platforms" accepts every platform with a valid profile, as the UCP specification describes. "Listed platforms only" accepts only the platforms you enter below.
ucp.profileDomainSingle: The channel's single domain is used automatically.
ucp.readOnlyMessage: You can view this configuration, but only users with UCP edit permission can change and save it.
ucp.unsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Check the Preview tab, then save the sales channel to apply them.
ucp.webhookHostNotListed: Order updates for this sales channel are sent to {host}. Your developer has set this webhook URL. Add {host} to the list as well, or ask your developer to remove the webhook URL.
